<thought>The carbon NMR spectrum shows peaks at 143.10, 139.03, 135.88, 129.50 (twice), 129.01 (twice), 128.90 (twice), 128.50 (twice), and 127.20 ppm, all within the typical aromatic region (≈110–160 ppm). That accounts for 12 aromatic carbon atoms.</thought>
